dangers.label: Rust Devil ground (the Corvega Factory)
dangers.note: The Rust Devils' kingdom in the Capital Wasteland and the ground their patrols work: the factory, its outskirts, the Corvega townships nearest it and Vault 108's door. Light patrols out here (the vault's Rust Devils Plan, RD4 c and the RD6 ruling).
